story: At 9:17 on this breezy, clear Thursday in Sumter Oaks, Gary is test-fitting light strips and speaker brackets at his house, careful not to mount anything permanent just yet. Across town, Donna is packing paddles, balls, and water for doubles practice with Gary, both of them determined to be ready. Hal, watchful as ever, is counting the flamingos along Magnolia Loop to make sure there are only three, while Rosa, content at her house, is arranging the dining table for four so Hal, Gary, and Donna can mingle over place settings.
events: Gary (gary golf cart): Test-fit the light strips and speaker brackets without mounting anything permanent
Donna (donna pickleball bag): Pack paddles, balls, and water for doubles practice with Gary
Hal (donna flamingo flock): Count the flamingos visible from the street to confirm there are only three
Rosa (rosa dining table): Check table seating for four and plan place settings so Hal, Gary and Donna mix

gary.thought_process: I've got the parts list and wiring notes done, and the Architectural Review application is the only legal path for visible cart mods under L-01. I looked at the mailbox kiosk earlier, but I haven't confirmed the form is actually filed. I'm home at the cart with nobody around, so this is a good hour to do something hands-on that won't violate anything: test-fit the light strips and speaker brackets on the cart without permanently mounting anything, so I'm ready the moment approval comes through. Keep the sound off, no point annoying anyone before I'm cleared.

parameters.content: Test-fit the light strips and speaker brackets without mounting anything permanent

donna.thought_process: I'm at home Thursday morning with nobody around. I reserved a 2-hour practice slot for Pruitt-Kowalski and confirmed it against my calendar, so the logistics are handled. Next step is getting Gary ready for the ladder, and my pickleball bag is right here. I'll check that my paddle, balls, and water are packed so we're set to go, then find Gary and lock in the time. Rosa's dinner is Saturday, so I need to keep the schedule tidy.

parameters.content: Pack paddles, balls, and water for doubles practice with Gary

hal.thought_process: I'm on Magnolia Loop with nobody in sight, and I came out to scan the street out of habit. Donna said she trimmed the flamingos down to three, so the L-02 complaint is moot unless she lied, and she doesn't. Still, a supply sergeant verifies the count himself. The flock is right here to check. After that I can see whether Gary's cart is parked right, and then get ready for Saturday at Rosa's.

parameters.content: Count the flamingos visible from the street to confirm there are only three

rosa.thought_process: I'm home in the kitchen at 9:17 on Thursday. I already wrote the menu and shopping list last tick and checked my shift schedule, so Saturday evening is clear. Donna is covering the lemon bars. Gary said yes to Donna, and Hal is the new neighbor, so my table is set. Nothing left to ask anyone. The next useful step is to actually look over the finished menu and shopping list at the dining table, work out the seating so Hal, Gary and Donna mix, and confirm the table fits everyone before I head out to shop.

parameters.content: Check table seating for four and plan place settings so Hal, Gary and Donna mix

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
